# This vault

A machine-curated markdown vault, kept organized by the BigBrain engine.
Everything in here is content — the code lives in the engine checkout.
Agents: `CLAUDE.md` is your operating contract; this file explains the
storage model it assumes.

## The storage model: three layers

**The lake — what the world delivered. Immutable.**
Every arrival (a meeting transcript, a web clip, a dropped file) appends
one `source.inserted` event under `log/insertions/` — the arrival's
permanent, never-edited original, envelope and text together. That event
is the one durable write. Binary payloads don't enter git at all: they
live in `.blobs/`, a content-addressed store keyed by sha256, referenced
from the item's envelope as `blob:<sha256>`. Nothing edits the event log;
when a source revises something it already sent, the revision arrives as
a NEW insertion that marks what it supersedes.

**Projections — what we can query and understand. Rebuildable.**
A dossier for each thing the record knows about, generated on demand from
the assertions that name it — `projection/entities/<id>.md`, a path the
viewer and the API serve rather than a file on disk. The claims behind
them are `log/assertions/`: attributed, each citing the insertion it came
from, written when your own agent tends the vault (the gardener —
`bigbrain tend`, or `/bigbrain:tend` from any connected Claude Code).

`references/` and `entities/` are the reference era's on-disk projections,
frozen: readable forever, never added to, and empty in a vault created
today.

**Memory — the working set. Derived.**
`memory/` is a small, budgeted distillation of the record — what an
agent should know before it knows what to ask. Written ONLY by the
memory pass, which folds in voice arrivals (observations, directives)
and the record's recent changes. Memory cites into the record; the
record never cites into memory.

## Who writes where

| Tree | Writer | Everyone else |
|---|---|---|
| `log/` | intake + the gardener's settles (append-only) | read; `bigbrain drop` to add |
| `references/`, `entities/` | nobody — frozen (the reference era) | read |
| `.blobs/` | intake (add-only) | read via the host |
| `memory/` | the memory pass | read; feed via `bigbrain observe` |
| `journal/` | the machinery (its run ledger) | read |
| `queue/`, `requests/`, `observations/` | nobody — frozen (pre-#498 work trees) | read |
| `vault.yaml` | you (human-edited configuration) | — |

The full contracts — roles, doors, door fidelity, link rules — live in
`CLAUDE.md`.
